name: Standing Street Vendor Advisory Committee Regular Agenda 08222023
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE
  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
  STANDING STREET VENDOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Tuesday, August 22, 2023 - 4:30 p.m.
  El Monte City Hall East
  City Council Chambers
  11333 Valley Boulevard
  El Monte, California

1.  CALL TO ORDER / FLAG SALUTE

2.  ROLL CALL

3.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

4.  CLOSED SESSION

  4.1  Closed Session Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(2) –
  Conference with Legal Counsel – Anticipated Litigation – One (1) Matter.

5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  Minutes of May 17, 2023

6.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  Members of the public may comment provided such comments are within the subject
  matter jurisdiction of the Committee. Speakers will be given 2 minutes to speak per
  person. The Committee may not deliberate or act upon matters not appearing on
  the agenda but may direct staff to place the matter on a future Committee agenda.

7.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS

  7.1  Receive staff presentation and provide direction on proposed mobile food
  vendor (food trucks) ordinance.

8.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS

9.  ADJOURN MEETING

  Agenda Posted on August 17, 2023 at 1:05 p.m.
